text: 。声明指出，这一抗心衰药物，与阿托伐他汀、氟伐他汀、匹伐他汀、普伐他汀、瑞苏伐他汀和辛伐他汀等存在潜在药物间相互作用，建议考虑小剂量他汀。 来源：[1] Michael O'Riordan. AHA Provides Guidance on Drug-Drug Interactions With Statins and CVD Medications. Tctmd. Monday, October 17, 2016.[2] Wiggins BS, Saseen JJ, Page RL, et al. Recommendations for management of clinical significant drug-drug interactions with statins and select agents used inpatients with cardiovascular disease. Circulation, 2016 Oct 17.
